notes.title: Watch the new trailer for The Final Fragment!
notes.notes:
[h3][b]We’re so excited to reveal the trailer for The Final Fragment during The Ukrainian Games Festival 2025![/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Check out the trailer to get a feel for the game![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="zTrGXq9WLxI;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
Throw away failed poems, pretend you know what you’re doing and listen to the music until it fades. [/p][p][/p][p]As you immerse yourself into the warm interiors of the Kobylianska Arts Academy, pay attention to everything. [b]The Final Fragment is a tender character study, where every accidental breath, word or look might hide secret feelings.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Also don't forget to follow us for updates on our socials, such as [/b][b][url="https://x.com/mahousparkle"]Twitter[/url][/b][b], [url="https://web-cdn.bsky.app/profile/mahousparkle.bsky.social"]Bluesky[/url] and [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@mahousparkle"]Tiktok[/url]![/b][/p]
